hooks.name: Session Start Reminder
hooks.description: Reminds the agent about project constraints at the start of every session

action.prompt: This is a Life Dashboard project built with pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript. Key constraints: only ONE CSS file in css/ and ONE JS file in js/, no frameworks, no backend. All data goes through browser Local Storage. The design follows an Apple-minimal aesthetic using CSS custom properties (design tokens). Always maintain these constraints when making changes.
